name: BC Web API
description: HTTP API (@skyline/web): auth, buildings, collect, image upload/serving. Runs privileged DB migrations and role provisioning under an advisory lock, then serves with the restricted skyline_web role.

env.description: Postgres connection string (postgres://user:pass@host:port/db). In an OCD stack this is derived at boot as skyline_web from POSTGRES_URL, WEB_DB_PASSWORD and POSTGRES_DB; the separate owner URL is used only for startup migrations. Leave this unset for stack deploys.
Postgres user for the stack-derived DATABASE_URL. Must match the BC Postgres member.
Postgres password for the stack-derived DATABASE_URL. Must match the BC Postgres member's POSTGRES_PASSWORD.
Postgres database name for the stack-derived DATABASE_URL. Must match the BC Postgres member.
Password for the restricted skyline_web runtime role.
Password provisioned for the restricted skyline_worker role.
Password provisioned for the restricted skyline_detector role.
Password provisioned for the read-only skyline_backup role.
Auth signing secret — generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.
Public https origin this API is served at, e.g. https://api.example.com.
Public auth base URL — normally identical to BASE_URL.
Comma-separated origins allowed for auth/CORS; include the admin console origin.
Email-verification OTP provider. Production refuses to start unless this is 'resend'.
Resend API key for verification-OTP emails.
From address for verification emails, e.g. noreply@example.com.
Port the server listens on inside the container. Must match container_port.
Keep 'true' behind the platform's TLS-terminating reverse proxy so rate limiting keys on x-forwarded-for instead of the proxy address.
At least 32 random characters used to HMAC persisted IP/email/phone/user rate-limit keys.
Accepted image uploads allowed per account per UTC day.
Accepted upload bytes allowed per account per UTC day.
Phone/SMS auth feature flag — dormant for launch (China-only, later). Enabling also requires the SMS_PROVIDER/ALIYUN_* variables.
SMS provider used when phone auth is enabled; only 'aliyun' is production-safe.
Aliyun SMS access key ID.
Aliyun SMS access key secret.
Approved Aliyun SMS sign name.
Approved Aliyun verification template code.
WebAuthn relying-party ID for admin-console passkeys — the admin domain, e.g. admin.example.com. Production refuses to start without it.
WebAuthn origin for admin-console passkeys, e.g. https://admin.example.com. Production refuses to start without it.
Sign in with Apple client ID (optional social login).
Sign in with Apple client secret.
Native Sign in with Apple client ID (the iOS bundle identifier).
Apple client-secret JWT generated for APPLE_NATIVE_CLIENT_ID; required to revoke Apple tokens during account deletion.

's3' (production default) stores image blobs via the S3_* settings — all of web/worker/detector must point at the same bucket. 'local' only works when all services share one filesystem (docker-compose).
Max Postgres connections for the app pool.
Max Postgres connections for the auth pool.
Where telemetry events go.
Content moderation provider. Only 'openai' is currently implemented.
OpenAI project API key used for text moderation.
OpenAI moderation model.
Georank: compass bearing sigma in degrees.
Georank: detection box height sigma.
Georank: view-bearing window for embedding re-rank matches.
Georank confidence margin in nats. With EMB_RERANK=1, an embedding-backed mismatch blocks collection only above this margin. Empty keeps ranking shadow-only.
Set to 1 to enable DINOv2 building-reference re-ranking and embedding-backed collection verification. Empty = disabled.
